translation: If one can know this, [so that] the gathering and dispersing of the true qi all [proceed] through this gate and aperture, then the Tianmen (heaven gate) will constantly be open, and the Dihu (earth door) forever closed; the coccyx-vessel (kao mai) will circulate throughout the whole body, penetrating through above and below, and the harmonious qi will naturally ascend to the court; yang grows and yin wanes, fire bursts forth in water, and flowers bloom in snow. This is what is called 'the heaven-root and moon-cavern come and go at leisure, and in the thirty-six palaces it is all spring.' He who attains it is light of body and nimble, his failing looks returning to vigor, in a dazed and heedless state, as if drunk, as if foolish — this is its verification.
